metadata_description: Current security direction, role boundaries and deployment responsibilities.
title: Security designed around clear boundaries
description: Practicora combines local-first continuity, account controls and role-aware access. Production safety still depends on correct deployment and review.
item_1_description: Navigation and protected routes verify permissions instead of relying only on hidden buttons.
item_2_description: Personal and institutional workspaces are separated conceptually and require database policies in a live Supabase environment.
item_3_description: Email verification, password recovery, optional PIN protection and explicit confirmation support safer access.
item_4_description: Audit, support and platform controls are reserved for authorized roles and documented in the control centre.
review_notice: This page describes the implementation direction. It is not a certification, penetration test or legal security opinion.
